{"metadata":{"description":"External vision proxy extension for DeepSeek Harness, enabling text-only models to analyze and understand images via OpenAI-compatible vision APIs.","id":"gh:1339201380","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-ext-vision-proxy","slug":"jin123-alpha/dsh-ext-vision-proxy","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"External vision proxy extension for DeepSeek Harness, enabling text-only models to analyze and under"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"stand images via OpenAI-compatible vision APIs."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-ext-vision-proxy"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> External vision proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling text-only LLMs (such as DeepSeek-V3 / "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"DeepSeek-R1) to inspect, analyze, and understand images via OpenAI-compatible vision model APIs."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 📸 Screenshots"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### 1. Settings Panel (Configuration & Provider Management)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### 2. Chat Composer Switch (Pill-shaped Toggle & Model Selector)"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 🌟 Key Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **🖼️ Multimodal Power for Text-Only Models**: Allows text-only LLMs to autonomously invoke the `vi"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"sion_describe` tool to inspect and answer questions about images, screenshots, diagrams, and attachm"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ents.
- **🔘 Native Composer Switch**: Integrates seamlessly into the chat input bar (`conversation.i"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"nput.left`) with a pill-shaped toggle switch and an interactive model dropdown selector.
- **⚙️ Dedi"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"cated Settings & Connectivity Testing**: Provides an intuitive configuration panel in the Settings p"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"age supporting custom Base URLs, API Keys, vision model filtering, and one-click connectivity testin"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"g.
- **🎛️ 4-State Session Matrix**:
1. **Multimodal LLM + Switch ON**: `vision_describe` tool is vis"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"ible. Model can choose native or delegated recognition. Prompts confirmation dialog upon image attac"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"hment.
2. **Multimodal LLM + Switch OFF**: Tool is stripped. Model processes images natively via sta"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"ndard DSH image messaging with zero proxy interference.
3. **Text-only LLM + Switch ON**: Tool is vi"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"sible. Images are admitted without rejection; the LLM automatically invokes `vision_describe` with t"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"he attachment ID or file path.
4. **Text-only LLM + Switch OFF**: Tool is invisible. Behavior is 100"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"% identical to not having the plugin installed.
- **🔍 Intelligent Attachment & Image Resolution**: R"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"esolves content-addressed hashes (`sha256:...`), local file paths, HTTP/HTTPS URLs, and automaticall"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"y detects MIME types using binary magic bytes."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 🏗️ Architecture"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Host (Node.js)**: `src/index.ts`
- Registers the `vision_describe` tool schema and execution han"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"dler.
- Dynamically filters tool exposure via the Cordis `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall hook bas"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ed on session state.
- Exposes REST API endpoints on `webServer` for settings, model probing, and se"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ssion state sync.
- **Client (React / Browser)**: `src/client/`
- Registers the `settings.section` s"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"lot (`VisionSettingsSection`) for provider configuration.
- Registers the `conversation.input.left` "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"slot (`VisionComposerButton`) for composer toggling and fast model switching."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 📦 Installation & Setup"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Option 1: Link in DSH Profile (Recommended for Development)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Add the dependency and bundle entry in your `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Option 2: Build & Pack"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## 🚀 Getting Started"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. **Start DSH Web**:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"2. **Configure Vision API**:
- Open DSH Web in your browser (`http://127.0.0.1:3080`).
- Navigate to"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" **Settings -> 视觉代理 (Vision Proxy)**.
- Enter your OpenAI-compatible Vision API Base URL (e.g., `htt"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ps://api.openai.com/v1` or local endpoint) and API Key.
- Click **获取模型列表 (Fetch Models)** and select"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" your desired default vision model (e.g., `gpt-4o`, `gemini-2.5-flash`, `qwen-vl-max`).
- Click **测试"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"连通性 (Test Connection)** to verify API connectivity, then save settings.
3. **Chat & Inspect Images**"},{"id":"p21s6","text":":
- In any conversation with DeepSeek-V3 or DeepSeek-R1, turn the **视觉代理** switch **ON**.
- Upload o"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"r paste an image and ask questions (e.g., *"What is shown in this image?"*).
- The LLM will call `vi"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"sion_describe` behind the scenes and respond with detailed answers."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## 📄 License"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"MIT © 2026 Fan Yuejin"}],"truncated":false}
